question: The Indira Gandhi Prize for Peace, Disarmament and Development was first awarded in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1986**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Indira Gandhi Prize for Peace, Disarmament, and Development was **first awarded in 1986**.
 
• The prize was **instituted** in the **memory** of the **former prime minister **by a trust(**Indira Gandhi Memorial Trust**) set up by her name in **1986**
